description: This file contains implementation of Orleans streaming grains and observer classes for testing streaming functionalities, including producer and consumer grains with inline and external observers.

classes.name: SampleConsumerObserver<T>
classes.description: An internal class implementing IAsyncObserver<T> to observe stream items and log events.

classes.name: SampleStreaming_ProducerGrain
classes.description: A grain implementing a streaming producer, capable of starting/stopping periodic production and managing stream lifecycle.

classes.name: SampleStreaming_ConsumerGrain
classes.description: A grain implementing a streaming consumer that subscribes to a stream and counts received items.

classes.name: SampleStreaming_InlineConsumerGrain
classes.description: A grain implementing an inline stream consumer with inline subscription handlers.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles incoming stream items, logs, and increments the count of consumed items.

methods.name: OnCompletedAsync
methods.description: Handles stream completion event, logs the event.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Handles stream error event, logs the exception.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Configures the grain as a stream producer with specified stream ID, namespace, and provider.

methods.name: StartPeriodicProducing
methods.description: Starts a timer to periodically produce stream items.

methods.name: GetNumberProduced
methods.description: Returns the number of items produced so far.

methods.name: ClearNumberProduced
methods.description: Resets the count of produced items.

methods.name: Produce
methods.description: Triggers a produce action, calling the internal Fire method.

methods.name: TimerCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked by the timer to produce an item if the timer is active.

methods.name: Fire
methods.description: Sends the current count as a stream item and increments the count.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain deactivation, logs the event.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Configures the grain as a stream consumer and subscribes to a stream.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns the number of items consumed so far.
